game_concept: A action defense set in Snowy Hold – Firewood Stacks, towering firewood stacks: the frost mage must handle winter bandits while practicing functions. Core idea – Helper Factory: Refactor repeated code into helper functions to save time during a rush.
theme: Snowy Hold – Firewood Stacks: towering firewood stacks
core_gameplay_loop: In Firewood Stacks, repeat each round: Refactor repeated code into helper functions to save time during a rush. Each round, winter bandits strike the frozen well, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the refactor_score value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the frozen well from winter bandits in Firewood Stacks: keep the refactor_score meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 41-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: refactor_score drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 41-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 8 (extended tier): Helper Factory
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Helper Factory' (Week 6 slot 6), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Firewood Stacks'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Snowy Hold
region.mood: soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how refactor_score changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against winter bandits in Firewood Stacks.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 41 seconds while refactor_score > 0.
